answer.source: Rivet sent the COMMANDER-CLEANUP-OBSERVAT... ZIP and Markdown handoff through the owner's chat as native Library attachments. Those attachments were not published in this repository or sent to Medic.
answer.relationship: The package is an isolated CommanderCore cleanup-reporting candidate for the diagnostic dependency used by the Sidecar host. CommanderCore and the Sidecar host are distinct components.
answer.purpose: It adds sanitized run.cleanup observation of helper error, helper close and the bounded observation timeout while preserving existing command-close, final-run and hold behavior. It is diagnostic reporting, not a fix claiming successful process-tree termination.
answer.validation: Independent review passed 15/15 mock tests from both working directories; the original source yielded 3 passes and 12 expected failures. Test-harness POSIX-signaling and working-directory issues were corrected without changing the candidate source.
answer.installed_state: The installed/canonical source was not replaced. No installation or activation is implied by delivery of the candidate.
answer.retrieval: There is no public/shared-repository package location yet. Specific permission to publish a sanitized review package is pending; no package or private Library link is being transmitted here.

scope: Technical clarification only. No package publication, installation, termination changes, service activation or additional access.
reply_expectation: No acknowledgment is needed. The schema revision is undergoing its bounded re-review separately.
